source_note: Labels are the March 2026 viz CSV made by safe-control-gym generate_quadrotor_2d_visualization.py (400 x 400 cell centres, others at the goal), same checkpoint, plant settings, 1200-step horizon and 0.2 goal ball as the dataset collector, label = env goal_reached at termination. One env per worker process was reused across cells (the dataset collector builds a fresh env per flight). The CSV lists the first-named dim slow; here the first-named dim is horizontal, so the original viz png (second dim horizontal) is this grid transposed. model_states use the exact generator grid; the CSV rounds to 6 decimals (max diff < 6e-7). Re-fly of 300 seeded cells (150 within 2 cells of the boundary) with the dataset collector's own process_single_trajectory at PyBullet default damping 0.04 (the plant behind every shipped quadrotor dataset and so behind the paper's labels): 0 disagree; at damping 0 (today's library): 23 disagree. box = D_test start hull (stratified grid, x/x_dot/z_dot in [-0.72, 0.96]); dataset_description bounds are [-1, 1].

re-flown at PyBullet damping 0.04 on the k100 lattice (paper plant); original k100 labels were zero damping, differing on 38 cells. Each of the 9801 lattice starts (k100 cell centres, others at the goal) was flown once with the dataset collector's own process_single_trajectory (fresh env and controller per flight, 100/5000 Hz, 1200 steps, same safe_explorer_ppo checkpoint) and labelled by its _process_trajectory_file: success iff the last row is within 0.2 (L2, full 6-D) of [0,1,0,0,0,0]. Collector labels -1/0/1: {'-1': 0, '0': 1114, '1': 8687}; env goal_reached disagrees with that rule on 0 cells (ties at the 0.2 ball after 6-decimal rounding). The same harness re-flies 299/300 seeded D_test rows of the paper's labels. Against the viz CSV cell containing each lattice cell: 34/9801 disagree (1 away from the viz boundary); the zero-damping labels disagreed on 48. box = D_test start hull (stratified grid, x/x_dot/z_dot in [-0.72, 0.96]); dataset_description bounds are [-1, 1].
